description: Full-text search for mods across Nexus Mods by free-text term, optionally scoped to a single game. Returns matching mods with name, author, game, mod ID, summary, download/endorsement counts, and a nexusmods.com page URL. This is the only Nexus tool with real keyword search.

game_domain.description: Optional game domain to scope the search (e.g. 'skyrimspecialedition'). Omit to search all games. Use nexus_list_games to find domains.

limit.description: Max number of hits to return. Default 10, max 50.

query.description: Free-text search term (matched against mod names, e.g. 'inventory sorter').

name: nexus_search
title: Search Nexus mods
